_meta.what: Per-sector feed for Textiles & Apparel: the sector's registered channels with today's published scores, 95% sampling bands, and weights under the registered exposure rule. IGRM measures press salience -- the share of global news coverage matching registered channel dictionaries, ranked against each channel's own trailing two years. It is not a measure of risk and makes no forecasts. This feed re-cuts published numbers by one registered sector's frame and adds no new claim.

label: Textiles & Apparel
rationale: Export-led to US/EU; goods move via Red Sea/Suez westbound; tariff policy is the demand-side lever.
